import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 66;
    static int r, c, n;
    static String s;
    static long[][] comb = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[] cnt_a = new long[MAXN];
    static long[] cnt_b = new long[MAXN];
    static List<Long>[] part;
    static List<Long>[] part_zero;

    static void build_comb() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++)
                comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j];
        }
    }

    static long diff(int conf, int a, int b) {
        long res = 0;
        int i = 0;
        while (i < c + 1) {
            if ((conf & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                ++b;
                long u = comb[b - 1][r - 1];
                long v = comb[n - b][r] - comb[a][r];
                res -= u * v;
            } else {
                ++a;
                long u = comb[a - 1][r - 1];
                long v = comb[n - a][r] - comb[b][r];
                res += u * v;
            }
            ++i;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static boolean ok(int conf) {
        for (int i = 0; i < c + 1; i++) {
            char ch = s.charAt(2 * r + c + i);
            int bit = (conf >> i) & 1;
            if (ch == 'A' && bit == 1) return false;
            if (ch == 'B' && bit == 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void second_part() {
        int lim = 1 << (c + 1);
        for (int conf = 0; conf < lim; conf++) {
            int b = Integer.bitCount(conf);
            int a = c + 1 - b;
            long val = diff(conf, r + c - a, r + c - b);
            if (ok(conf))
                part[a].add(val);
            else
                part_zero[a].add(val);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; i++) {
            Collections.sort(part[i]);
            Collections.sort(part_zero[i]);
        }
    }

    static long coef(int conf) {
        int i, j;
        for (i = 0; i < c + 1; i++)
            if (((conf >> i) & 1) != (conf & 1))
                break;
        for (j = i; j < c + 1; j++) {
            char ch = s.charAt(2 * r - 1 + j);
            int bit = (conf >> j) & 1;
            if (ch == 'A' && bit == 1) return 0;
            if (ch == 'B' && bit == 0) return 0;
        }
        int sa = r - 1 + ((conf & 1) == 0 ? i : 0);
        int sb = r - 1 + ((conf & 1) == 1 ? i : 0);
        if (sa < cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
        if (sb < cnt_b[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
        return comb[sa + sb - (int)cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i] - (int)cnt_b[2 * r - 2 + i]][sa - (int)cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i]];
    }

    static void upd(long[] ans, long[] act) {
        if (act[0] < 0) act[0] = -act[0];
        if (ans[0] < act[0]) return;
        if (ans[0] > act[0]) {
            ans[0] = act[0];
            ans[1] = act[1];
            return;
        }
        ans[1] += act[1];
    }

    static long cnt_eq(List<Long> v, long x) {
        int l = Collections.binarySearch(v, x);
        if (l < 0) return 0;
        int left = l, right = l;
        while (left >= 0 && v.get(left) == x) left--;
        while (right < v.size() && v.get(right) == x) right++;
        return right - left - 1;
    }

    static long first_part() {
        int lim = 1 << (c + 1);
        long[] ans = new long[]{1L << 60, 0};
        for (int conf = 0; conf < lim; conf++) {
            int b = Integer.bitCount(conf);
            int a = c + 1 - b;
            long act = diff(conf, r - 1, r - 1);
            long cf = coef(conf);
            
            List<Long> list = part[c + 1 - a];
            int idx = Collections.binarySearch(list, -act);
            if (idx >= 0) {
                if (ans[0] >= Math.abs(list.get(idx) + act)) {
                    long c2 = cnt_eq(list, list.get(idx));
                    upd(ans, new long[]{list.get(idx) + act, cf * c2});
                }
            } else {
                idx = -idx - 1;
                if (idx < list.size()) {
                    if (ans[0] >= Math.abs(list.get(idx) + act)) {
                        long c2 = cnt_eq(list, list.get(idx));
                        upd(ans, new long[]{list.get(idx) + act, cf * c2});
                    }
                }
                if (idx > 0) {
                    idx--;
                    if (ans[0] >= Math.abs(list.get(idx) + act)) {
                        long c2 = cnt_eq(list, list.get(idx));
                        upd(ans, new long[]{list.get(idx) + act, cf * c2});
                    }
                }
            }
            
            cf = 0;
            list = part_zero[c + 1 - a];
            idx = Collections.binarySearch(list, -act);
            if (idx >= 0) {
                if (ans[0] >= Math.abs(list.get(idx) + act)) {
                    long c2 = cnt_eq(list, list.get(idx));
                    upd(ans, new long[]{list.get(idx) + act, cf * c2});
                }
            } else {
                idx = -idx - 1;
                if (idx < list.size()) {
                    if (ans[0] >= Math.abs(list.get(idx) + act)) {
                        long c2 = cnt_eq(list, list.get(idx));
                        upd(ans, new long[]{list.get(idx) + act, cf * c2});
                    }
                }
                if (idx > 0) {
                    idx--;
                    if (ans[0] >= Math.abs(list.get(idx) + act)) {
                        long c2 = cnt_eq(list, list.get(idx));
                        upd(ans, new long[]{list.get(idx) + act, cf * c2});
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return ans[1];
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        r = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        s = br.readLine().trim();
        s = " " + s; // 1-indexed like in C++
        
        n = 2 * (r + c);
        build_comb();
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            cnt_a[i] = cnt_a[i - 1] + (s.charAt(i) == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            cnt_b[i] = cnt_b[i - 1] + (s.charAt(i) == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }
        
        part = new ArrayList[c + 2];
        part_zero = new ArrayList[c + 2];
        for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; i++) {
            part[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            part_zero[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        second_part();
        long sol = first_part();
        System.out.println(sol);
    }
}
